outcome: Adherence rates to individual ERAC protocol elements (ketorolac administration, ondansetron administration, active warming methods)
cohort: The study included 7,812 cesarean delivery patients enrolled in an Enhanced Recovery After Cesarean (ERAC) program at two New York hospitals.
finding: Black and Asian patients had significantly lower odds of ketorolac administration compared to white patients, a disparity that persisted both before and after ERAC program implementation, while no racial differences were found in overall ERAC adherence or other specific metrics like ondansetron and active warming.
